analysis.generalization_boundary: Applies to 3D/cinematic/game assets whose final quality depends on source geometry/material structure. It does not require hero-density geometry for distant/systemic objects whose actual screen-space role is already satisfied.
analysis.mechanism: Final visual fidelity is bounded by the information quality of the source asset. Cosmetic polish on low-information blockout/proxy geometry increases effort but cannot reliably repair wrong silhouette, proportion, construction, semantic part separation or close-up parallax. High-value identity assets therefore need an explicit source-fidelity gate and, when they fail, an Asset Factory route before final lookdev.
non_applicable_cases: systemic assets intentionally below hero exposure when their screen-space requirement is proven
analysis.symptom: Agents spend repeated waves adding materials, noise, puddles, greeble, lighting or object count while hero-visible assets still read as blockout/proxy geometry.

evidence.claim: Nacre explicitly identifies that technically strong macro/reproducibility evidence remains far from AAA identity/material fidelity and defines a multiview -> image-to-3D bakeoff -> structural review -> Blender cleanup path.
Aurora explicitly classifies its current result as semantic production blockout/checkpoint, with final UV/PBR/topology/rig/LOD still open.
Elysium explicitly reports low-information blockout source geometry and keeps direct human art, final UV/PBR and GATE-ASSET/GATE-ART open.
The correction is converted into an explicit fail-closed source-fidelity gate, asset-state lattice, Asset Factory router and render-economics contract.

promotion.reason: Prevent repeated proxy-polish loops and route identity-critical assets through source creation/reconstruction before final lookdev.

revalidation_condition: Revalidate provider-specific routes/costs when catalogs change; revalidate runtime derivative budgets when engine/target hardware changes. Core blockout-vs-hero distinction remains unless contradicted by direct production evidence.
unknowns: Per-provider reconstruction quality varies by asset class and must be bakeoff-tested.
Final engine and target hardware remain project-level open decisions.
Current provider prices/capabilities are live data and must not be frozen as permanent constants.

adversarial_review.notes: Protocol preserves valid blockout/gameplay/collision work and does not require hero-density geometry for all runtime objects.

runtime_test.notes: Machine gate has dedicated unit tests in tests/test_aaa_asset_gate.py; project-wide Gauntlet remains manual-cost-quarantined.
